In summary, our research is concerned with
the optimization and application of simultaneous SFE and ChD for the GC-MS determination of amphetamines in water.

the development of a new method, simultaneous SFE-Chd, for the extraction and derivatization of analytes from aqueous samples and the evaluation of its optimal conditions by means of Taguchi’s quality method.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the optimal experimental conditions thus obtained for simultaneous SFE-Ch D are: pressure, ~4000 psi; static extraction time, ~5 min; temperature, ~90 ̊ C; amount of TCA, 100 μL, and the best robust quantitation of the analytes in aqueous matrices can be achieved by the use of the optimal levels for the four influential parameters.

the optimal levels for the four influential parameters have been determined by Taguchi’s method, which have led to the best robustness and the highest mean recoveries for amphetamines in aqueous matrices.
the simultaneous SFE-Chd of AP and MA from aqueous matrices is a robust, efficient and reproducible method, which can be applied to the determination of amphetamines in water with a high sensitivity.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the combination of simultaneous SFE-Chd and Taguchi’s quality control method is an effective approach to the optimization of the analytical procedures for amphetamine and methamphetamines in water.
Taguchi’s method has been proven to be a powerful and effective tool for optimizing the experimental conditions and hence the performance of the analytical methods.

the application of the simultaneous SFE-Chd method has significantly improved the extraction efficiency of amphetamines, the use of the Taguchi’s method has significantly reduced the number of experiments, and the combination of the two methods has significantly improved the robustness of quantitation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
Taguchi’s method is not limited to a particular experimental setup but can be readily applied to any other analytical procedure to achieve the best experimental conditions.

the simultaneous SFE-Chd method is superior to the stepwise SFE- ChD procedure in the recovery of amphetamines and that Taguchi’s quality-engineering method is a powerful tool in optimizing the analytical conditions of a complex analytical process.
